note: AZ IDs are the same physical place in every account; AZ names (us-east-1a) may map to different AZ IDs per account in the oldest Regions. Regions outside the commercial partition (GovCloud, European Sovereign Cloud) have no published AZ ID table: azIds is empty and the city draws the documented minimum of three. Service status: available, planned (with a launch quarter), considering, not-planned, or outside-partition. Where a service's own Regions page disagrees with the tool, the page wins (docs.overrides).
